NRLM SCHEME
The loans may be used by members of SHGs for meeting social needs, high-cost debt swapping, construction or repair of house, construction of toilets and taking up sustainable livelihoods or to finance any viable common activity started by the SHGs. In higher doses, emphasis will be on income generating activity.
Eligibility Criteria
SHGs promoted in rural areas under DAY NRLM scheme.
SHGs should be in active existence for at least 6 months as per their books of accounts (and not from the date of opening of S/B account).
Should satisfy the Grading parameters set by NABARD/MoRD.
Micro Credit Plan mandatory from Third dose Onwards
Loan Amount
Minimum Loan Amount: Rs 1,50,000
Maximum Loan Amount: Rs 20,00,000
Facility
Both Term loan and Cash Credit is permitted
Term Loan – 24 Months to 84 Months
Cash Credit – 12 Months – subject to yearly review/ renewal.
Security & Margin
For loans to SHGs up to ₹10.00 lakh, no collateral, and no margin.
For loans to SHGs above ₹10 lakh and up to ₹20 lakh, no collateral will be obtained and margin not exceeding 10% of the loan amount.
CGFMU cover will be applicable for Loans Above Rs 10 Lakh
Loan Documents
Loan Documents as prescribed by IBA.
Interest Rate
Concessional Rate of Interest for all rural women SHGs assigned with Unique Code under DAY-NRLM. Tiered ROI – Based on Outstanding
Outs. Upto Rs 3 Lakh – 7%
Outs above 3 Lakh & Upto 5 Lakh – 1Yr. MCLR
Outs. above 5 lakh & Upto 10 lakh - 1 Yr. MCLR + 1.40% = 10.40% p.a
Outs above 10 lakh – 1 Yr. MCLR + 1.20% = 10.20% p.a
ROI on outstanding above Rs 5 lakh will be applicable as per Banks extant guidelines and subjected change from time to time.
Minimum – 7%, Maximum -10.40% , Average – 9.65%. (Subjected to change from time to time based on banks Guidelines)
Other Charges
Nil Charges (Subjected to change from time to time based on banks Guidelines)
